The '''ronk''' was a vicious [[Feline/Legends|feline]] carnivore native to the planet [[Cilpar]]. The [[Gender/Legends|male]] ronk was considered a delicacy by the locals, while the female was fatally poisonous. Bodies were often cremated before a ronk would get to it. They were known to be attracted to light.
